name: Sour clam soup
summary: Canh ngao nấu chua is the soup course of a Hạ Long seafood meal. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, says it is usually ngao ta or ngao tây, and names canh cá song and riêu hà as the other soups in that slot.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015. The Cái Dăm table in that account served ngao tây nấu chua.
howToEat: A sour soup of local clam or ngao tây. The souring ingredient for this soup, as distinct from the hotpot, was not printed.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The soup course of the ordinary meal. Not a named stall.
seoTitle: Canh ngao chua — sour clam soup in Ha Long
seoDescription: The Hạ Long seafood meal uses a sour soup of ngao ta or ngao tây. Canh cá song and riêu hà are the other soups in that slot. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
